name: Logo
typeSystem: Dynamic; classic Logo's principal data types are words and lists, with numbers represented as words that arithmetic operations recognise. Procedures are named workspace objects rather than generally first-class values. Logo is best known for turtle graphics and educational use.
runtime: Traditionally interpreted directly from source, designed to give learners immediate, interactive feedback as they drive an on-screen (or physical, robotic) turtle.

runtimes.name: UCB Logo interpreter
runtimes.role: Reads and executes Logo commands directly, typically updating turtle graphics on screen live as each line runs.

concurrencyModel: Dialect-dependent; classic UCBLogo is single-threaded, while some later Logo-family systems add concurrency.

codeExample.caption: Draw a square using turtle graphics
codeExample.source:
to square :size
  repeat 4 [ forward :size right 90 ]
end

square 100
